title: Front matter of a group
description: The YAML front matter of a group (groups/G<number>.md). The identifier is the file name. A group has no scope fields.

name.description: A speaking name: lowercase words joined by hyphens. It may change; only the identifier counts.

status.description: planned: published and citable, binds nobody yet. active: in force. retired: the file stays.

replaced-by.description: The group that took the place of a retired group.

rules.description: The identifiers of the rules of the group.
